page.layout: One page of text: running head at top with page number at top right; a heading in two lines above a woodcut illustration; below the woodcut, a verse epigram in italic lines with a large initial T; a signature mark at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Mare ventis agitatum, & Rex hinc Pontificem Romanum ad dextram, inde Cardinalem ad sinistram habens. XXII.
main_text.p: [Woodcut illustration: a king and a pontiff on the left, a cardinal, and rough sea with waves and figures on the right; described under notes.]
TRanquilli immotique prius velut aquoris undas

l.i: Sic mundum meretrix Romana. Hanc tollite, Reges,

page.notes: The woodcut shows three figures on a shore at left (a pontiff in a tall hat, a king in a cap and doublet, and a cardinal in a hat) with a rough sea and waves at right. The initial T of the first verse line is a large decorated letter; the first line reads "Tranquilli immotique prius velut aequoris undas" as printed with a long-s style and ligature forms, transcribed as closely as the scan allows. The signature mark at the foot is "Q iiij", the last letter partly obscured.
